description: Reads the raw board: each bookmaker's own prices for the events of one sport, in play too when in_play asks. Serves every region: region takes one code, or several international codes joined by commas (us,global) read as one board; uk is asked alone, and exchange prices are in uk only. Name markets and bookmakers to keep the reply short. Spends tokens: priced first, and refused when it would cost more than max_tokens. Paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor within five minutes; each page is priced.

bookmakers.description: Only these bookmaker or exchange keys, from the bookmakers tool for the region

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous reply, with the same other arguments

in_play.description: exclude (the default): pre-match events only. include: in-play events too. only: in-play events alone.

limit.description: Most events to return; a note counts the rest

markets.description: Only these market keys, such as h2h; coverage lists product raw's keys

max_tokens.description: Refuse the call when its quoted price is above this many tokens. Ask the user before raising it.

region.description: One region code, or several international codes joined by commas (us,global), read as one board and priced as their sum. uk is always asked alone. Left out, the API uses uk, or refuses with region_required and names the code to send.

sport.description: Which sport: soccer, or a competition key from the sports tool

name: raw_odds
title: Raw odds
